title_ar: ETL والـDAGs: التحقق قبل التحويل، والجودة، والـquarantine، وAirflow
title_en: ETL and DAGs: validate before transform, six quality dimensions, quarantine, Airflow inside, idempotent retries
how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

storyboard_notes.text: Restating dive: treat it as a visual callback that reuses the trunk chapter's assets (see `restates` in continuity); the fact-checker checks its numbers against the trunk.

sentences.ar: يلا بينا ندخل على طول في التفاصيل الممتعة اللي بتحصر وراء الكواليس في عالم هندسة البيانات
sentences.en: Let's dive straight into the fascinating details of what happens behind the scenes in data engineering.

sentences.ar: الرحلة دي مليانة أسرار عن ازاي الشركات الكبيرة بتنظم ويدير الـ data بتاعتها من غير ما الدنيا تقع بيهم
sentences.en: This journey is full of secrets about how big companies organize and manage their data without everything falling apart.

sentences.ar: هنشوف اي اللي بيحصل بجد والمشاكل الحقيقية اللي بتظهر فجأة مش بس السيناريوهات المثالية اللي بنقرأ عنها
sentences.en: We will see what really happens and the real problems that suddenly show up, not just the ideal scenarios we read about.

sentences.ar: الـpipeline بتاعنا عبارة عن خمس محطات أساسية السجل اللي ده بيمر بيهم
sentences.en: Our pipeline is five main stations that this record passes through.

sentences.ar: المحطة التانية بقى وديه النقطة الجوهرية
sentences.en: The second station is the crucial point.

sentences.ar: بعد كده بنعمل load وأخيراً بنوصل للـconsumer اللي هيستلم الشغل ده
sentences.en: After that we load, and finally we reach the consumer who receives this work.

sentences.ar: طيب، إيه اللي بيحصل بالزبط في مرحلة الـvalidate؟
sentences.en: So what exactly happens in the validate stage?

sentences.ar: بصوا، العملية دي ممكن تبين روتينية ومملة بس مفيش أي غنى عنها
sentences.en: This process may look routine and boring, but there is no doing without it.

sentences.ar: عندنا السبع فحصات أساسية بتشتغل وراء بعض عشان تصطاد أي مشكلة بدري
sentences.en: We have seven core checks running one after another to catch any problem early.

sentences.ar: هل الـschema معتشت؟ الـdata types مزبوطة؟ الحقول الإجبارية أو mandatory fields كلها موجودة؟
sentences.en: Does the schema match? Are the data types right? Are the mandatory fields all present?

sentences.ar: هل في duplicates؟ الـkeys موجودة وسليمة؟ القيم جوه الـvalid ranges المسموح بيها
sentences.en: Are there duplicates? Are the keys present and sound? Are the values within the allowed valid ranges?

sentences.ar: وآخر حاجة هل الـcount matches source؟ يعني هل عدد الصفوف اللي وصل هو نفس العدد اللي المصدر بعتوه؟
sentences.en: And last, does the count match the source, meaning is the number of rows that arrived the same as the number the source sent?

sentences.ar: أول ما الداتا بتعدي من الفحوصات دي بتبدأ عدادات الجودة تشتغل
sentences.en: As soon as the data passes these checks, the quality counters start running.

sentences.ar: العدادات دي بتتفاعل دلوقتي مع 14 صف بيانات طلعوا من مرحلة التنظيف
sentences.en: These counters now act on the 14 data rows that came out of the cleaning stage.

sentences.ar: نقدر نعتبرهم مقياس الصحة الحقيقي لل14 صف دول جوه الـpipeline
sentences.en: We can treat them as the true health measure of these 14 rows inside the pipeline.

sentences.ar: وهنا بقى يجي وقت سؤال مهم
sentences.en: Here comes the time for an important question.

sentences.ar: تخيلوا معي الديتا دلوقتي شكلها نظيف ومثالي جدا بعد ما تنظفت
sentences.en: Imagine the data now looks clean and perfect after being cleaned.

sentences.ar: تفتكروا كام فحص من اللي تكلمنا عنهم هيفشل
sentences.en: How many of the checks we talked about do you think will fail?

sentences.ar: هل ممكن ديتا شكلها تفشل لما تنزل على أرض الواقع؟
sentences.en: Could data that looks clean fail when it lands in the real world?

sentences.ar: المفاجأة للإجابة هي اتنين
sentences.en: The surprising answer is two.

sentences.ar: الأهم بقى إن الصفوف دي مش بتتمسح وتختيفي في صمت
sentences.en: Most important, these rows are not deleted or silently made to vanish.

sentences.ar: وقبل ما نكمل رحلة السجل في قرار معماري مهم جداً لازم يتحدد
sentences.en: Before we continue the record's journey, there is a very important architectural decision to be made.

sentences.ar: إيه الفرق بين الـETL والـELT؟
sentences.en: What is the difference between ETL and ELT?

sentences.ar: طيب مين المايسترو اللي بينظم الليلة دي كلها؟
sentences.en: So who is the conductor that organizes this whole process?

sentences.ar: المايسترو ده اسمه الـDAG أو Directed Acyclic Graph ده عبارة عن graph موجه
sentences.en: This conductor is called the DAG, or Directed Acyclic Graph, which is a directed graph.

sentences.ar: مفيش فيه أي دورات مقفولة أو cycles ده بيدينا وعد قاطع بترتيب التشغيل
sentences.en: It has no closed loops, no cycles, which gives us a firm promise about the execution order.

sentences.ar: الحاجة بتشتغل ورا بعض بنظام دقيق من غير ما تعلق في دايرة للأبد
sentences.en: Things run one after another in a precise order without getting stuck in an endless loop.

sentences.ar: الـDAG بيضمن ان الـtasks تتنفس بترتبها المزبوط عن طريق حاجة اسمها topological sorting
sentences.en: The DAG guarantees the tasks execute in the right order through something called topological sorting.

sentences.ar: ومن اشهر الادوات اللي بتدير الـDAGs دي هي Airflow
sentences.en: One of the most famous tools that manage these DAGs is Airflow.

sentences.ar: لو بصينا على معمرية Airflow من جوة هنلاقيها متقسمة لاربع اجزاء بتشتغل مع بعض افتناغهم رهيب
sentences.en: Looking at Airflow's architecture from the inside, we find it split into four parts that work together in great harmony.

sentences.ar: الweb UI ده عشان الـmonitoring وانتابع منه اللي بيحصل
sentences.en: The web UI is for monitoring and following what is happening.

sentences.ar: الـScheduler وده العقل المدبر اللي بيعمل كوردينيشن وبيقرر مين يشتغل وامتى
sentences.en: The Scheduler is the mastermind that does the coordination and decides who runs and when.

sentences.ar: الـ Workers ودول العمال اللي بينفذوا الـ Execution بجد على الأرض
sentences.en: The Workers are the ones who actually carry out the execution on the ground.

sentences.ar: وأخيراً الـMetadata DB ودي الزاكرة اللي بتحفظ لـ State Tracking عشان الـ Scheduler يقدر ياخد قراراته صح
sentences.en: And finally the Metadata DB is the memory that keeps state tracking, so the Scheduler can make correct decisions.

sentences.ar: تعالوا نبص على كود حقيقي لـDAG شغال اسمه shopflow_daily_analytics
sentences.en: Let's look at real code for a working DAG, named shopflow_daily_analytics.

sentences.ar: الـ Parameters الأساسية هنا بتوضح إننا محددين الـ Retries بتلات مرات والـ Retry Delay 5 دقائق
sentences.en: The main parameters here show that we set the retries to three times and the retry delay to 5 minutes.

sentences.ar: والـexecution timeout أقصى وقت مسموح للـtask هو ساعة واحدة
sentences.en: And the execution timeout, the maximum time allowed for a task, is one hour.

sentences.ar: الـschedule مكتوب 0 6 يعني بتشتغل كل يوم الساعة ستة الصبح
sentences.en: The schedule is written 0 6 star star star, meaning it runs every day at six in the morning.

sentences.ar: والـstart_date من 2024 شهر واحد يوم واحد
sentences.en: And the start date is from 2024, month one, day one.

sentences.ar: الإعدادات دي هي اللي بتخلي الـpipeline تمشي زي الساعة بالزبط
sentences.en: These settings are what make the pipeline run like clockwork.

sentences.ar: بس إيه اللي يحصل لو حاجة بوزت في النص؟
sentences.en: But what happens if something breaks in the middle?

sentences.ar: هنا بيبان زكاء الـ DAG Graph
sentences.en: Here the cleverness of the DAG graph shows.

sentences.ar: لكن الفروع الموازية أو اللي مش معتمدة عليها بتفضل خضرة وبتكمل شغلها عادي جدا ولا كأن في حاجة حصلت
sentences.en: But the parallel branches, the ones that do not depend on it, stay green and carry on with their work as if nothing happened.

sentences.ar: ده بيعزل الفشل ويخلي الـpipeline قوية جدا
sentences.en: This isolates the failure and makes the pipeline very robust.

sentences.ar: وهنا نوصل لسؤال التوقع التاني والأهم
sentences.en: And here we reach the second and most important prediction question.

sentences.ar: لو عندنا task كانت بتعمل load للديتا وكتبت نص الصفوف وفجأة فشلت ووقعت إيه اللي هيحصل لعدد الصفوف النهائي
sentences.en: If we have a task that was loading the data, wrote half the rows, then suddenly failed and crashed, what happens to the final row count?

sentences.ar: لما نظام Airflow يعمل Automated Retry أو إعادة تشغيل تلقائية لـtask دي من تاني هل الأمور هتمشي بسلام والعدد هيفضل زي ما هو؟
sentences.en: When Airflow does an automated retry, an automatic re-run of that task, will things go smoothly and the count stay as it is?

sentences.ar: للأسف دي كرسة حقيقية بنسميها Retry Disaster
sentences.en: Unfortunately this is a real disaster that we call a Retry Disaster.

sentences.ar: دي خدعة خطيرة جدا وممكن تدمر أي تحليلات مبنية على الداتا دي
sentences.en: This is a very dangerous trap that can ruin any analytics built on this data.

sentences.ar: وعشان المشكلة دي تتحل بندخل في مفهوم سحري اسمه idempotency الفرق شاسع
sentences.en: To solve this problem we enter a magical concept called idempotency; the difference is huge.

sentences.ar: لكن الـidempotency بتحل الموضوع بآلية زكية جدا
sentences.en: But idempotency solves the matter with a very clever mechanism.

sentences.ar: زي ما واضح في التايم لاين احنا بنقدر نعالج ويف 1 ويف 2 وويف 3 من التواريخ اللي فاتت
sentences.en: As shown in the timeline, we can process wave 1, wave 2 and wave 3 of the past dates.

sentences.ar: بفضل الـ idempotency وتحديد الـ partitions بنقدر نشغل الـ data الأديمة دي بأمان تيم
sentences.en: Thanks to idempotency and defining the partitions, we can run that old data safely.

sentences.ar: من غير أي overwriting أو تأثير على شغل النهاردة اللي بيكون محمي ومعموله blocked
sentences.en: Without any overwriting or any effect on today's work, which stays protected and blocked.

sentences.ar: وقبل ما الـ pipeline تخلص شغلها وتنشر الـ data للمستهلك لازم نعدي على بوابات التفتيش الـ quality gate checks
sentences.en: Before the pipeline finishes its work and publishes the data to the consumer, we must pass the inspection gates, the quality gate checks.

sentences.ar: البوابات دي صارمة جداً وبتتأكد من الأرقام النهائية
sentences.en: These gates are very strict and verify the final numbers.

sentences.ar: مثلاً لو عادت الطلبات Zero Orders ده وضع Critical ولازم يؤف
sentences.en: For example, if the order count comes back as Zero Orders, that is a Critical state and it must stop.

sentences.ar: لو متوسط قيمة الطلب AOV أقل من 10 ده بيدي Warning
sentences.en: If the average order value, AOV, is less than 10, that gives a Warning.

sentences.ar: ولو عادت العمل Zero Customers ده برضو Critical
sentences.en: And if the customer count comes back as Zero Customers, that is also Critical.

sentences.ar: لو أي فحص من دول ضرب وفشل النتيجة بتكون Gate Activated النشر أو الـpublishing بيتعمله Blocked فوراً
sentences.en: If any of these checks fails, the result is Gate Activated, and publishing is Blocked immediately.

sentences.ar: ليه بنعمل كده؟ لأن مجرد أن الـtasks لونها أخضر واشتغلت مش معناه أبداً أن الداتة نفسها صح؟
sentences.en: Why do we do this? Because the mere fact that the tasks are green and ran does not mean the data itself is right.

sentences.ar: البوابة دي بتحمي الـconsumer وبتخلي الـdashboard تفضل تعرض داتا مبارح yesterday's dashboard وهي سليمة بدل ما نعرض داتا النهاردة وهي بايظة وتعمل بلبلة
sentences.en: The gate protects the consumer and keeps the dashboard showing yesterday's data, yesterday's dashboard, which is sound, instead of showing today's data while it is bad and causing confusion.

sentences.ar: ولما الشغل بيكبر والـpipeline بتتعقد Airflow بيقدم أدوات متقدمة قوية جدا
sentences.en: And when the work grows and the pipeline gets complex, Airflow offers very powerful advanced tools.

sentences.ar: عندنا الـSensors زي File Sensor اللي بيستنى ملف من 5 دقايق لساعة
sentences.en: We have sensors, like File Sensor, which waits for a file from 5 minutes up to an hour.

sentences.ar: وSqlSensor اللي بيفحص الداتا كل 300 ثانية لحد 7200
sentences.en: And SqlSensor, which checks the data every 300 seconds up to 7200.

sentences.ar: وفيه الـBranching عشان نختار مصارات تشغيل مختلفة حسب الموقف
sentences.en: And there is branching, so we can choose different execution paths depending on the situation.

sentences.ar: وكمان الـDynamic DAGs والـcallbacks اللي بتبع التنبيه لو اتأخرنا عن الـ SLA اللي هو ساعتين 2 hours
sentences.en: And also dynamic DAGs and callbacks that send the alert if we run late against the SLA, which is two hours.

sentences.ar: وطبعاً الـTaskFlow API اللي بيخلي كتابة الـDAGs سالسة وأسهل بكتير
sentences.en: And of course the TaskFlow API, which makes writing DAGs smooth and much easier.

sentences.ar: عشان كده الخلاصة كلها متجمعة في الـ 6 Pipeline Best Practices دول
sentences.en: That is why the whole summary is gathered in these 6 pipeline best practices.

sentences.ar: أولاً الـidempotency اللي شرحناها
sentences.en: First, the idempotency we explained.

sentences.ar: ثالثاً task granularity إن كل task تعمل حاجة واحدة بس ومحددة
sentences.en: Third, task granularity: each task does one specific thing only.

sentences.ar: رابعاً مفيش أي passwords تتكتب في الكود
sentences.en: Fourth, no passwords written in the code.

sentences.ar: خمساً وأخيراً ولازم نختبر الـDAG نفسه ونتأكد إن الـDagBag بتساوي صفر ومفيش أي cycles تعملت بالغلط
sentences.en: Fifth, and finally, we must test the DAG itself and make sure the DagBag equals zero and that no cycles were made by mistake.

sentences.ar: وكده الداتا بتاعتنا عدت من كل البوابات ووصلت بنجاح لآخر الـpipeline وما بقاش فيها أي تكرار أو مشاكل جودة
sentences.en: And so our data passed all the gates and reached the end of the pipeline successfully, with no duplication or quality problems left in it.

sentences.ar: بس السؤال اللي بيطرح نفسه دلوقتي الداتا النظيفة والمثالية دي هتتحمل فين بالزبط بعد كل ده
sentences.en: But the question that comes up now is where exactly will this clean, perfect data be loaded after all of this?

sentences.ar: وإزاي بتتنظم وديتهيكل عشان يتعامل عليها deep analysis وتحليلات معقدة
sentences.en: And how will it be organized and structured so deep analysis and complex analytics can be done on it?

sentences.ar: ده بقى اللي بيفتح لنا الباب لعالم كبير جداً من الـdata warehouses والـstar schemas واللي أكيد محتاج شرح كامل لوحده
sentences.en: That is what opens the door to a very big world of data warehouses and star schemas, which certainly needs a full explanation on its own.

sentences.ar: شكراً جداً لمتابعتكم وأتمنى تكونوا استمتعتوا بالرحلة دي
sentences.en: Thank you very much for following along, and I hope you enjoyed this journey.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.

first_mention_gloss.gloss_ar: إن تكرار نفس الطلب ما يعملش أثر زيادة

glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
A payload travelling through 2-8 stations; a station can fail and be fixed.
A DAG of tasks whose states change on anchors (queued/running/success/failed/retry/skipped).
Repeated deliveries with one idempotency key stamp once.
Deep-Dive entry card with parent chapter and prerequisite concepts.
